name: Belratti
summary: Cooperative team of painters and curators tries to match pictures to themes while filtering out random fakes slipped in by Belratti.
rules_text: Two picture cards are themes. Muse managers (Cats) choose a number 2-7 to request, without discussing themes. Painters (Owls) privately look at hands and together lay exactly that many cards face down, each secretly assigned to one theme, discussing only fit quality (good/medium/bad). 4 random cards from the deck are added as Belratti fakes and shuffled. Cats then openly discuss and select cards they believe are from painters, assigning each to one theme, discarding 4 as fakes. Painters reveal which cards were theirs and which theme they intended. Team scores 1 per card assigned to its intended theme. Belratti scores 1 per fake assigned to any theme. Discard all open cards. Refill painters hands, rotate Cat/Owl roles clockwise, lay 2 new themes. Repeat until Belratti reaches 6 points, then count team points.
rating_reason: Bluffing fake art insertion, hidden information and guessing.
reasons: capability: needs something the manifest has no word for: subjective thematic matching
capability: needs something the manifest has no word for: joker powers
